sayLines: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 1 tile to grove.
— Nut trees —
Mast crunches underfoot — last season's nuts, sprouting or rotting. The trees don't waste anything.
Something moves out there — something wearing a crown of bone, bellowing at the dusk.
Movement — a chipmunk, cheeks already full.
👁 Spook it and it's down a hole you never saw. Block the burrow mouth, or hunt it in the open where the hole can't help.
The creek runs fast here — no crossing without a bridge or a swim.
